source: validated scale32 pilot5 numerical core byte-identical; duration upgrade to100 using prior scale64 reference100 runner structure
scope: 100 complete train-only SVHN epochs; fresh initialization; three modes from one current E4M3 source
quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
mantissa_mapping: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; unchanged E2M3 scale equals original E4M3 scale times32
loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) for E4M3 and complete scale32 E4-to-E2 code path; no extra factor32 in backward; retain original G(W) derivatives; no gradient through codes or scales
shared_scale_policy: encode current E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; both lower scale codes equal source code+5; integer promoted before addition; overflow above254 rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks; source scales can change after optimizer steps
source_cache_policy: detached integer source and derived codes; one triplet per minibatch; cleared before Adam
selection: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
reporting: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch
reference_comparison: actual scale64 reference100: epoch100 and common E4M3-best checkpoint per training; partial histories compared only within shared observed range
research_outcome_policy: low accuracy, constant predictions or zero finite gradients/updates are diagnostics, not automatic FAIL
